scope: Retrospective exact linear algebra and formula-normalization audit; no new descent or point search.
comparisons: All 21 pairs of the seven retained labelled class spaces.
pencil_selection: Examine pairs of nonzero deformations whose pairing difference is nondegenerate on their whole common space. The unique qualifying pair is (-1,1); this is retrospective selection, not a prospective prediction.
pencil_endpoint: Certify a simultaneous orthogonal decomposition and the nilpotent chain lengths, without interpreting linear-algebra blocks as soluble Mordell-Weil blocks.
gauge_selection: First three retained Fisher pairs in each source, independent of their pairing values. The separately formatted u=-1 transcript is excluded from this formula audit only.
gauge_endpoint: Test all 72 rational rescalings of gamma. Recompute exact local symbols and prove complete support for the change; global pairing must remain invariant.
limits: Matrices at most 20 by 20; 18 retained pair entries and 72 rescalings; no factorization campaign, number-field construction, parameter sweep, or live-search edit.
interpretation: Solubility obstruction. Neither a restricted CT radical nor a simultaneous pencil component proves a rational point. Local formula summands are representative-dependent.
